about: Fig. 12 linear sloshing modes of the Guinness tulip, by tools/fig12/modes_fem.py sweep (finite elements, P2, mesh 48 x 96 on the meridian section). Elevation of mode (m, n): beta(t) e(r) cos(m theta). m = 1 obeys beta'' + 2 zeta omega beta' + omega^2 (1 + a_z/g) beta = -(omega^2/g) c a_x. Surface-skin factor LamS (1/m; zeta_skin = sqrt(nu/(2 omega)) LamS / 2, an inextensible surface, Lamb 1932 Art. 351); bulk factor Bk (1/m^2; zeta_bulk = nu Bk / omega). Momentum relative to the glass rho sum Ix q'; crest volume on the high half per unit wall height Vc. Wall-friction damping zeta = (1/2) sqrt(nu/(2 omega)) Lam (laminar Stokes layer).
